# <span id="aanchor116"></span> Meter Class Editor

Meter class indicates the overall "meter purpose" and is used to provide categories for grouping meters within viewers and reports. The Meter Class Editor allows users to create user-defined classes in a measurement system to label and categorize the use of meters. Examples of meter classes include: Sales, Receipt, Delivery, Transportation Gas, Fuel, Blow Down, Water Draw and Construction Loss.

To realize the full benefit of class subtotals, careful planning and coordination should be done with other departments that utilize FLOWCAL data.

Your organization will need to determine if meter class subtotaling is required prior to setup and configuration of balance locations. Some organizations meet the subtotaling requirements through the creation of sub-balances.

Enable subtotaling by meter class in the [FLOWCAL Configuration](FLOWCAL%20Configuration.md#SubtotalClass) screen.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Meter Class Editor:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  In the **Application** group, click **Meter Class**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 359;height: 390;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Reviewing">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Reviewing Meter Classes</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Reviewing">

<div class="procedure">

To edit or add a meter class:

1.  Open the Meter Class Editor.
2.  Select a meter class name from the list and click **Edit**.
3.  To create a new class, click **New**.
4.  To change or enter a meter class name, click in the name field and enter a new class name.
5.  If necessary, specify an optional code for each class.
6.  Click **Save**.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Deleting">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Deleting Meter Classes</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Deleting">

<div class="procedure">

To delete a meter class:

1.  Open the Meter Class Editor.
2.  Select the meter class to be deleted.
3.  Click **Delete**.

If a class is assigned to one or more meters or tickets (i.e., it is still in use on at least one meter or ticket), then it cannot be deleted.

</div>

</div>
